howtoplay.title: How to Use the Random Tool
howtoplay.intro: This activity helps you practice creating a quick prototype from a short client brief. In real projects, you'll often receive only limited information. Your challenge is to turn that into a creative solution.
howtoplay.subTitle: How to Use
paragraph: 1. Randomize a Mission Card to receive a client persona with a unique profession and design request.
2. Create a prototype based on the brief. It can be a sketch, wireframe, mockup, model, graphic, concept, or even a physical product idea.
